package.title: Chat-list members in GET /chats: kill the avatar N+1 and patch avatar changes point-wise

specification.intent: Remove the chat-list avatar N+1: GET /chats returns member briefs (id, login, display_name, avatar_url) batched as one IN query over all listed chats, capped at 10 per chat by joined_at (dialogs never truncated); the frontend adapter maps the dialog companion's real avatar with the pool fallback inside a pure toChatInfo(response, meId) mapper driven by an additive fetchChats(meId?) port parameter; the controller drops its per-chat getChatUsers enrichment and applyCompanionAvatar entirely; changeChatAvatar patches the single chat's avatar in the Store from the port's {avatar} return instead of refetching the whole list.

requirements.title: GET /chats carries batched member briefs
requirements.description: ChatResponse gains members: list[ChatMemberBrief] with default_factory=list (POST /chats and GET /chats/{id} keep their model_validate path alive and return members: []); ChatMemberBrief matches the GET /chats/{id}/members shape and both are assembled by one shared to_member_brief helper (avatar_url reuses schemas/file.py); ChatRepository.list_members_for_chats(chat_ids) is a single IN query ordered (chat_id, joined_at, user_id) — zero per-chat member requests from the list endpoint; ChatService.members_for_chats groups with MEMBERS_BRIEF_CAP = 10 (dialogs never truncated) and is used ONLY by GET /chats — GET /chats/{id}/members keeps its full uncapped list ordered user_id ASC, regression-pinned; the unread_counts query shape is untouched (consolidating it is out of scope); no migration.

requirements.title: Frontend: companion avatar from the list response, point-wise avatar patch
requirements.description: ChatsPort.fetchChats gains an additive meId?: number parameter (the adapter never reads the Store); toChatInfo(response, meId) is a pure mapper with the avatar ladder chat.avatar_url > companion real avatar_url > avatarPoolUrl(companion.id) > '' and the lone-non-me-member rule (group chats, meId undefined or missing members -> no companion); controller.fetchChats computes meId once and issues zero getChatUsers calls; applyCompanionAvatar is deleted; changeChatAvatar reads the chat id from the same FormData chatId field the adapter reads (port contract stays {avatar}), patches the one chat through chatsSlice.setChats without calling fetchChats (operator requirement 2026-10-25); stale comments claiming GET /chats carries no members are purged.
requirements.source: docs/NEXT.md priority 1 + operator requirement 2026-10-25 (no full refetch on one avatar change)

specification.goal: One request loads the chat list with dialog companion avatars (real avatar with pool fallback); avatar changes update the list point-wise.
constraints: Layers downward only; guard-architecture --all --strict stays green; the api layer never reads the Store (meId comes from the controller).
ChatResponse.members default is load-bearing: POST /chats and GET /chats/{id} build via model_validate(chat) and must keep returning members: [].
Avatar URL convention unchanged: files-relative "{file_id}/download" values render through fileUrl, leading-"/" values are app static assets (the pool).
The WS getToken->connect loop of fetchChats stays untouched (port contract); call sites of controller.fetchChats do not change.
No migration: alembic heads output must not change.
Existing suites stay green; test counts grow from the 319 mocha / 181 pytest baseline.
nonGoals: WS push for avatar changes (NEXT priority 2 territory)
populating members in POST /chats and GET /chats/{id} beyond the empty default
consolidating the unread_counts query (keeps its current shape; separate NEXT debt)
the ai-assistant copy of the chats DTO (backward compatible, untouched)
the mark_viewed check-then-insert tail (separate NEXT item)
specification.scope: backend/ chat schemas, repository, service and chats endpoints with their pytest; frontend chats feature (ports, own adapter, controller) with mocha; docs/NEXT.md and the progress log.

criteria.title: Batched member briefs in GET /chats
criteria.statement: GET /chats returns members in the GET /chats/{id}/members shape via one shared helper, batched as a single IN query — zero per-chat member requests (unread_counts keeps its shape, out of scope); briefs capped at 10 per chat by joined_at ASC, user_id ASC with dialogs never truncated; GET /chats/{id}/members keeps its full uncapped user_id ASC list (regression-pinned); POST /chats and GET /chats/{id} keep returning members: []; pytest covers the dialog companion case, the cap and order, the uncapped /members list, and the default-field regression.

criteria.title: Zero member requests from the chat list
criteria.statement: toChatInfo(response, meId) resolves the dialog companion's real avatar with pool fallback (lone-non-me rule; group chats, meId undefined or missing members stay empty); controller.fetchChats issues zero getChatUsers calls (mocha regression); changeChatAvatar patches one chat through chatsSlice.setChats without fetchChats; applyCompanionAvatar deleted.

criteria.title: Gates and bookkeeping
criteria.statement: npm run verify and npm run verify:backend pass with grown test counts (319 mocha / 181 pytest baseline); guard-architecture --all --strict zero violations; alembic heads unchanged; progress log entry and NEXT.md update; no file outside the manifest write-sets changes.

releaseImpact: GET /chats response shape (additive members field) and the chats feature controller/adapter; no router, auth, WS protocol or deployment changes.
